# Arachnids
Eight-legged humanoids with a knack for silk craft. Their Blue Blood is based on Copper rather than Iron.
## Diet
- Can eat raw meat without ill effects. - Will get poisoned by Theobromine (Chocolate, Tea, Coffee) and Allicin (Onion, Garlic).
## Benefits
- Have two additional Pocket slots in their inventory. - Unarmed attacks deal Piercing damage instead of Blunt.
## Special
- Sericulture: arachnids can produce Websilk at the cost of getting more hungry. Only arachnids can craft bundles of websilk into clothing, shields, and even walls.
## Drawbacks
- [color=#ffa500]Suffocate 50% faster[/color] than other species. - Blue Blood can't be regenerated from Iron - they need Copper-based replenishment instead.
